_comment: Copy this file to config/supabase.json and fill in the two values.
config/supabase.json is gitignored; this example is not.
Where to find them: Supabase dashboard -> your project -> Project Settings
anon = the key labelled 'anon' and 'public' (newer dashboards call it
'publishable'). This one is DESIGNED to ship inside client code;
row-level security is what protects the data, not the key.
NEVER put the 'service_role' key (newer dashboards: 'secret') here or
anywhere near the app. It bypasses row-level security entirely, so a copy
of it in the page would hand every user's private spots to every other
user. build_interface.py decodes the key and refuses to build if it sees
a service_role one, but do not rely on that - just never copy it.
